propositions: The packaged top-level CLI help (overview.txt) documents unlink without an optional relation argument, contradicting the current optional relation parameter accepted by rebar.unlink and rebar unlink.
The ticket-model documentation (docs/ticket-model.md) states unlink takes no relation argument, failing to reflect the shipped relation-scoped unlink feature added in commit 73abb5805f.
The event-schema documentation (docs/event-schema.md) uses pre-change operation wording and does not distinguish optional relation selection from the emitted link-UUID cancellation.
Omitting the relation argument must retain the most-recent-relation fallback behavior as the historical default contract.
Explicit canonical relation removal must preserve other active relations on the source-target pair while canceling only the specified relation.
